scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U pergolafr -d pergolafr -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < Postgres/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U pergolafr -d pergolafr -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < Postgres/seeds/001_seed.sql
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U pergolafr -d pergolafr
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres adminer && sleep 3 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
